description:
Watch new companies matching a search; one saved search is free.
The saved search stores the exact /api/busca criteria and rejects invalid criteria. Alerts cover companies added in future monthly Federal Revenue releases, without searching previous releases. From the second search onward it uses the same paid slots as CNPJ watches; 402 opens the existing purchase flow. The portfolio provides 99 shared slots at the current price.

consulta.description: {tipo,q,filtros}: the search contract, with a term or filters.

filtros.description: The existing /api/busca filter specification. Invalid/discarded filters are rejected.

q.description: The same query as company search; empty when using filters alone.

credito.description: Authorized global credit token (cred_…). The first search does not debit it.

nome.description: Name to recognize the saved search.
